about: ZIM Integrated Shipping Services Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides container shipping and related services in Israel and internationally. The company offers door-to-door and port-to-port transportation services for various types of customers, including end-users, consolidators, and freight forwarders. It also provides ZIMonitor, a reefer cargo tracking service, a device attached to the engine of the reefer, and allows customers to track and monitor, cargo, such as pharmaceuticals, food and delicate electronics.
